Connect your market data

This preview displays sample data. Your Python app serves this same interface with Angel One prices.

  1. Download and extract the source project.
  2. Install the requirements in a Python virtual environment.
  3. Copy .env.example to .env, set MARKET_MODE=live, and add your API key, client code, PIN and TOTP secret.
  4. Run the command below, then open http://127.0.0.1:8000.
python -m uvicorn backend.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

Credentials stay on your Python server. Live prices refresh every five seconds; historical candles refresh every thirty seconds.
